searchText: Doesn't a BAL exceeding Erigon 's upper bound require breaching the 200M block gas limit by a big margin? I encountered this during audit but decided it cannot happen under the current schedule Are we spamming such that each block is 1% greater in terms of block gas limit and after N such increases we arrive at a BAL that breaks Erigon? Curious what N is in this case
